changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[Rule_AfterDelete] GO
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[Rule_AfterInsert] GO
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[Rule_AfterUpdate] GO
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_Rule_RuleType') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Rule] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_Rule_RuleType] end GO
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Rule]') AND type in (N'U')) DROP TABLE [dbo].[Rule] GO

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[RuleType_AfterDelete] GO
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[RuleType_AfterInsert] GO
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[RuleType_AfterUpdate] GO
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_RuleType_DisplayFormat') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleType] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_RuleType_DisplayFormat] end GO
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[RuleType]') AND type in (N'U')) DROP TABLE [dbo].[RuleType] GO
